top_bar_trigger.style: flex items-center justify-between w-full bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-sm p-4 rounded-md hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors
top_bar_trigger.active_badge: inline-flex items-center justify-center px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold leading-none text-white bg-blue-600 rounded-full ml-2

collapsible_panel.style: bg-white border border-slate-200 border-t-0 rounded-b-md shadow-lg p-6 overflow-hidden

inputs.style: flex h-10 w-full rounded border border-slate-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600 focus:border-transparent transition-all
inputs.label: mb-2 block text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-600

buttons.apply: bg-[#0176D3] hover:bg-[#014486] text-white font-medium py-2 px-6 rounded transition-colors shadow-sm
buttons.reset: bg-transparent hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border border-slate-300 font-medium py-2 px-6 rounded transition-colors

slider.thumb: h-4 w-4 rounded-full border-2 border-blue-600 bg-white ring-offset-background transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-blue-600 focus-visible:ring-offset-2
slider.track: relative h-1.5 w-full grow overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-slate-200

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons and interactive elements must darken on hover or change background. Links should have an underline effect or color shift.
motion_and_interactions.focus_states: All inputs must have focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600.
motion_and_interactions.panel_animation: Use framer-motion AnimatePresence to slide down the panel smoothly.
motion_and_interactions.staggered_entrance: Filter inputs should fade in slightly staggered when the panel opens.

accessibility.test_ids: MUST include data-testid on every interactive element (e.g., data-testid='filter-toggle-btn', data-testid='filter-apply-btn', data-testid='filter-reset-btn', data-testid='category-select').
accessibility.aria_labels: Include aria-expanded on the toggle button and aria-controls linking to the panel.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards. The blue-600 (#0176D3) on white is accessible.

iconography.instructions: Use Filter, ChevronDown, ChevronUp, X for reset, Calendar for date picker.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard layout with a Top Navigation and main content area.
Implement the Collapsible Filter Panel at the top of the content area. The panel trigger should always be visible and display an active filter count badge when filters are applied.
Use standard HTML + Tailwind for structural layouts, but utilize Shadcn UI components for complex interactions: Select (for dropdowns), Popover+Calendar (for Date Range), Slider (for thresholds).
Ensure the panel layout uses a responsive grid (1 col mobile, 2 cols tablet, 4 cols desktop) for the filter inputs.
Include an action bar at the bottom of the expanded panel with 'Reset Filters' (ghost/outline) on the left and 'Apply Filters' (solid blue) on the right.
Make sure inputs have labels styled with uppercase, small text, and wide tracking.
Use Framer Motion for the expand/collapse animation of the filter panel.
Use Shadcn UI components but override their default rounded-md to rounded (2px to 4px max) to fit the Salesforce Enterprise aesthetic.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements for testing.
Note: Ensure to output in .js/.jsx not .tsx files.
